meta.title: Mise — every order, chat and taka in one calm place
meta.description: Orders from Foodpanda, Pathao, WhatsApp, Messenger, QR and walk-ins in one place. Kitchen, stock, staff, credit and cash in step. Let Claude or Codex run a shift.

hero.headline:
Every order, chat
and taka, in one
calm place.
hero.lead: Mise keeps orders, kitchen, stock, staff, credit and cash in step for shops that run on chats. When you’re busy, an AI operator can take the shift.
hero.trustLine: Works with Foodpanda, Pathao, bKash, Nagad, WhatsApp, Messenger and Daraz. No APIs, no new hardware.

index.label: Everything a shop needs, each part explained below

ai.headline:
Hand over the shift.
Take it back in one tap.
ai.lead: Pick what the agent may do alone, what it must ask about, and what it only watches. It works next to your team: type in a chat and it steps back.

benefits.title: Limits it can’t cross
benefits.text: Set money limits, quiet hours and things it must never do, such as cancelling paid orders.

benefits.title: Every action logged, with undo
benefits.text: See what it did, why, and reverse it. Your staff see the same log.

benefits.title: Works next to people
benefits.text: A presence pill shows who handles each chat and order. Type in a chat and the agent steps back.

benefits.title: Never the only safety net
benefits.text: Kitchen alarms, missed orders and payment gaps still ring phones, even if the agent is offline.

ai.failureTitle: When something fails, it does what a person would
ai.failureText: Courier site changed? It switches to copy-and-paste. WhatsApp closed? It asks the desk. Nothing is dropped silently.
ai.connectTitle: Connect Claude or Codex in two minutes
connectCode: Claude  →  Customize › Connectors › Add custom connector
Codex   →  codex mcp add mise --url https://mcp.mise.app/mcp
ai.connectText: Start it once with a copied prompt. Scheduled check-ins or one live session per shift keep it going, and Mise tells you if it stops checking in.

ocr.headline:
Snap it, share it, forward it.
Mise understands it.
ocr.lead: When the agent can read a chat directly, no photo is needed. For everything else, such as screenshots, invoices, prescriptions, payment SMS and handwritten lists, Mise reads it and asks only when it’s unsure.

cards.title: Chat screenshots → orders
cards.note: From Messenger, WhatsApp, Instagram, or any app.

cards.title: Supplier invoices → stock and purchases
cards.note: Handwritten or printed. Unclear lines are flagged for you.

cards.title: Prescriptions → priced orders
cards.note: You check every line before anything is sold.

cards.title: Payment SMS → matched payments
cards.note: bKash, Nagad and bank alerts on the shop phone.

cards.title: Handwritten lists → orders
cards.note: Customers snap a list from the shop’s link.

cards.title: New website → read forever
cards.note: Point at the order number, name and total once.

capture.headline:
Your shop already makes the data.
Mise just catches it.
capture.lead: Each source has an automatic way in and a one-tap manual fallback, so nobody has to sit and type.

checks.headline:
Mise watches for the problems
so you don’t have to.
checks.lead: These run all day without an agent. When an agent is on, it acts on them; otherwise the right person gets a nudge.

detail.eyebrow: 05 · THE WHOLE OPERATION, PART BY PART
detail.headline:
Not just the AI.
Everything that keeps a shop running.
detail.lead: Each part works on its own, with or without an agent. Every step has an easy way to record it and a fallback when something breaks.

blocks.title: Every channel, one queue
blocks.lead: Delivery apps, chats, QR, calls and walk-ins land in one list. No APIs, no copying between screens.
steps: The browser extension reads Foodpanda, Pathao and Messenger tabs on the shop PC
The order phone reads WhatsApp, bKash and missed calls
Anything else: share a screenshot, or add it by hand in seconds
blocks.fail: Every 20 minutes Mise checks each delivery app against the queue and flags anything missing.

blocks.title: A kitchen screen nobody can miss
blocks.lead: Runs in a browser on any tablet or phone. No app store, no special hardware.
steps: New orders appear with a sound and a timer
The cook taps Got it, then Ready
Not seen in 2 minutes? The order phone rings and the desk is told
blocks.fail: If the internet drops, tickets keep working and sync when it’s back.

blocks.title: Customers track their own order
blocks.lead: QR orders turn into a live tracker. Chat and phone orders get a link.
steps: Guests who order by QR see their order move automatically
Chat orders get a link, sent by Mise or copied by staff
Running late? An honest delay notice goes out before they ask
blocks.fail: Link not opened? Staff get a nudge to message or call.

blocks.title: Stock in seconds, not spreadsheets
blocks.lead: Type or say what was used, snap the supplier invoice, and count at night one item at a time.
steps: “used 2 kg chicken” updates the right item
Target (par) minus on hand shows what to order
Supplier orders are drafted for you to send
blocks.fail: Mise compares counts with sales and flags gaps, such as waste or a missed entry.

blocks.title: Plan people and prep
blocks.lead: Need versus have, hour by hour, from your past weeks and local events.
steps: See which shifts are short before the rush
Ask the staff group to cover in one tap
The prep list reaches the kitchen at 3 pm
blocks.fail: No reply from the group? Mise reminds you to call someone.

blocks.title: Your team, without new apps
blocks.lead: Staff check in by saying it in the group, tapping the order phone, or opening their own link.
steps: The staff group is read for check-ins, stock notes and late messages
Shift reminders and alerts are posted back
Fair performance, from taps Mise already records
blocks.fail: Told you in person? Log it in one tap. It counts the same.

blocks.title: Know your regulars. Win them back.
blocks.lead: One profile per guest across QR, chats, calls and delivery apps.
steps: Ask for a phone number on QR orders, with a stamp in return
See who is drifting away
Send win-back messages one tap at a time, with copy and paste if an app won’t open
blocks.fail: No way to reach them? Staff are reminded to ask at the next visit.

blocks.title: Credit without awkward conversations
blocks.lead: For corner shops and regulars. Cash stays one tap; baki is there when you need it.
steps: Tap amounts like a calculator; cash is the default
Baki checks the person’s limit and sends a receipt
Polite monthly reminders; bKash payments close the entry
blocks.fail: Disagreement? Both sides see the same list, with who wrote each entry.

blocks.title: The whole store, live, from anywhere
blocks.lead: Owners and managers see orders, kitchen, cash, people, stock and channels on one screen, for every outlet.
steps: Stuck and late orders rise to the top
Money now: drawer, wallets and what delivery apps owe
Owners switch outlets; managers see their own
blocks.fail: A nightly summary of every outlet arrives on WhatsApp.

blocks.title: Your storefront, POS and QR menu
blocks.lead: The basics every shop expects, connected to everything above.
steps: Share your order link for delivery, pickup and pre-orders
Enter phone and walk-in orders on the POS in seconds
Print table QR codes; guests order and track
blocks.fail: Item sold out? Turn it off once and the QR menu, storefront and delivery apps update.

blocks.title: Online shop? Confirm, ship, get paid.
blocks.lead: Built for cash-on-delivery businesses that ship with Pathao, Steadfast or RedX.
steps: Confirm COD orders before packing; risky buyers are flagged
Courier forms are filled on the shop PC for you
Courier payouts are matched to every parcel
blocks.fail: Courier site changed? Copy-and-paste mode keeps you shipping.

blocks.title: Open in one tap. Export anything.
blocks.lead: Start service opens every chat and delivery tab and checks each device. Everything you record can leave with you.
steps: One tap opens and checks every channel
A setup checklist gets a new shop running in an evening
Excel, CSV, PDF or Google Sheets, on demand or every night
blocks.fail: Shop PC off? Listen on the order phone until it’s back.
